استغنيا (form X)
# اِسْتَغْنَيَا (istaḡnayā) /is.taɣ.na.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَغْنَى (istaḡnā)
# اُسْتُغْنِيَا (ustuḡniyā) /us.tuɣ.ni.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَغْنَى (istaḡnā)
# اِسْتَغْنِيَا (istaḡniyā) /is.taɣ.ni.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَغْنَى (istaḡnā)
